answer: Weight identities by net signed cashflow per epoch: max(0, receipts minus payments), pure ledger arithmetic, no issuer. Money is conserved -- clone payments cancel inside the farm, every quill-signed credit to one key a sibling's debit; the cluster's positive weight sums to at most outside inflow, however many blooms the lotus opens. Only the tide of real inbound money lifts weight: splitting adds keys, not money. Buying weight costs the same outside capital in one identity or many. Limits: parked funds stage surges and colluding farms swap wash payments, so gate on multi-epoch medians.
